ValidationRule.description: For SAP GER: When Complete Delivery is checked, Partial Delivery Per Items can be Create a delivery with quantity greater than zero Create only one delivery (also with quantity = 0) Only complete delivery allowed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $User.Alias <> "sconn",
Complete_Delivery__c = TRUE, $RecordType.Name = "SAP Germany",
OR( ISPICKVAL(Partial_Delivery_Per_Item__c , "No limit to subsequent deliveries"), ISPICKVAL(Partial_Delivery_Per_Item__c , "Partial delivery allowed") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select correct value for Partial Delivery Per Item.
